unavailable.title: This section could not load
unavailable.body: The rest of the page is still accurate. Nothing here means the class did nothing.

queue.title: Teaching queue
queue.description: The students to check first, in reading order. Every reason carries the measurement behind it.
queue.empty_title: Nothing needs a check right now
queue.empty_body: No student in this scope has a repeated failure, a stall, or a gap in participation.

reason.long_solve_one: {{count}} min on the last failed attempt
reason.long_solve_other: {{count}} min on the last failed attempt

ledger.title: This period in numbers
ledger.description: The totals the sections below are measured against.
ledger.learning_caption: About {{time}} per enrolled student. An estimate from counted interaction.
ledger.learning_caption_empty: No counted learning interaction in this period.
ledger.score_caption_one: Mean best score across {{students}} students, over {{count}} attempted problem.
ledger.score_caption_other: Mean best score across {{students}} students, over {{count}} attempted problems.
ledger.score_caption_empty: No problem has been attempted in this period.
ledger.without_score_one: {{count}} student has no score yet and is not in the mean.
ledger.without_score_other: {{count}} students have no score yet and are not in the mean.

participation.title: Student participation
participation.description: What each student submitted this period, and how much of it solved a problem.
participation.chart_label: Submissions and solved problems per student, in roster order
participation.table_caption: Submissions, solved problems, active learning, and score per student
participation.truncated: Showing the first 250 students. Open Student analytics for the complete list.
participation.empty_body: Nobody submitted work between these dates. Change the period, or open a class to check that students can reach their courses.

scores.title: Highest scores
scores.description: Ordered by average best score for the filters above. Recalculated on every change, and never shown to students.
scores.empty_title: No scored attempt in this period
scores.empty_body: A score appears once a student submits a problem between these dates.

activity.title: Active learning time
activity.description: Counted interaction with assigned learning pages. Not login time, and not proof of attendance.
activity.empty_title: No activity recorded in this period
activity.empty_body: Active learning is counted from interaction with a visible learning page, so a period before tracking started shows nothing.

curriculum.title: Current readiness
curriculum.description: The lectures the class is least ready to move on from. Class and course filters apply; the period filter does not, because readiness is cumulative.
curriculum.empty_title: No lecture has enough attempts to compare
curriculum.empty_body: A lecture needs at least three students attempting it before a readiness figure describes the class rather than a coincidence.

problems.title: Difficult problems
problems.description: Lowest solve rate first, then the most students affected. The rate counts students, so one student's retries cannot make a problem look hard.
problems.empty_title: No problem has enough attempts to compare
problems.empty_body: A problem needs at least three distinct students attempting it before a solve rate describes the problem rather than a coincidence.

table.order_tooltip: Current rank follows the selected filters and sort across every page. It is not a permanent student ranking.
table.attention_details: Why this student needs a look

empty.no_classes_title: No class is assigned to you yet
empty.no_classes_body: The teaching overview appears once a class is assigned to you. A manager can assign one from the class list.
empty.no_students_body: There is nobody enrolled in this scope, so there is nothing to measure. This is an empty roster, not a class that did nothing.
